description: Client state and persistence: the persisted Zustand store (RESOLVES design-review MEDIUM Finding 2 and NITs 3 & 4) and the Dexie IndexedDB layer. Depends on FEAT-002 (types, methods, notifications). Grounded in design.md Sections 8, 9, 18.
steps: Create src/store/types.ts: store-facing types (AppState shape per Section 8, including the actions signatures).

Create src/store/useAppStore.ts per Section 8: a single Zustand store with persist middleware, storage key 'heula-store', a version number and a migrate stub. State: onboarded, profiling (ProfilingAnswers|null), chosenMethod (MethodId), customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme ('system'|'light'|'dark'), reminders {endEnabled,startEnabled}, activeFast ({startMs,targetHours,planId,planLabel}|null), and a transient hydrated flag.
RESOLVE Finding 2 (MEDIUM): give customFastingHours a defined store default of 16 so onboarding can never land on an undefined custom target.

RESOLVE NIT 3 & 4: set the persist partialize whitelist to EXACTLY { onboarded, profiling, chosenMethod, customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme, reminders, activeFast } — the hydrated flag MUST be excluded from the persisted envelope (and from any transient action state). Set hydrated via onRehydrateStorage completion callback. dailyGoalHours on completeOnboarding defaults to the resolved method fasting hours (well-defined because custom is excluded from onboarding selection in FEAT-005).

Implement actions per Section 8: completeOnboarding(answers,method), setChosenMethod, setCustomFastingHours (store trusts input-layer clamp 8..23), setDailyGoalHours, setTheme, setReminders, startFast(now?) resolving targetHours = chosenMethod==='custom' ? customFastingHours : METHODS[chosenMethod].fastingHours and planLabel = chosenMethod==='custom' ? `Custom ${customFastingHours}j` : METHODS[chosenMethod].label, snapshotting both into activeFast; editStartTime(startMs) validating <= now; stopFast(now?) building a FastingSessionRecord from the activeFast snapshot (completed = durationMs >= targetMs computed once) and writing it to Dexie then clearing activeFast; rerunProfiling(answers,method); resetAll() clearing Dexie + resetting store to defaults.

In onRehydrateStorage completion: set hydrated=true; re-arm scheduleEndReminder for the remaining time when activeFast exists and reminders.endEnabled and the target end is still in the future (best-effort, no-op if notifications unsupported/denied).

Create src/db/db.ts per Section 9: `export class HeulaDB extends Dexie` with sessions!: Table<FastingSessionRecord, number>, version(1).stores({ sessions: '++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId' }); top-level singleton `export const db = new HeulaDB();` with NO typeof window guard and NO factory. File is imported only from "use client" modules.

Create src/db/sessions.ts per Section 9/18: add(record), remove(id), all() (orderBy startMs desc), clear(), last7Days(now); each wrapped in try/catch so quota/blocked failures are recoverable no-ops surfaced as friendly toasts (dev-only console.error).
acceptance_criteria: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes across src/store and src/db.
The persist partialize returns exactly the eight whitelisted keys and never includes `hydrated`.
customFastingHours has a numeric default of 16 in the store initial state.
startFast resolves custom target hours and label from the store (never the catalog placeholder 16) and snapshots them into activeFast; stopFast copies the snapshot verbatim into the stored record.
db.ts exports a top-level `db` singleton with the schema string exactly 'sessions: ++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId'.
verification: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm no type errors.
Run `npx vitest run src/lib` and confirm the FEAT-002 suites still pass (no regression from new imports).
findings: Created src/store/types.ts (AppState + ActiveFast/Theme/Reminders + PersistedState Pick of the 8 whitelisted keys), src/store/useAppStore.ts, src/db/db.ts, src/db/sessions.ts. Finding 2 resolved: customFastingHours default = 16 in INITIAL_STATE. NIT 3 & 4 resolved: partialize returns EXACTLY { onboarded, profiling, chosenMethod, customFastingHours, dailyGoalHours, theme, reminders, activeFast } and never hydrated; hydrated set in onRehydrateStorage completion callback (also re-arms scheduleEndReminder for remaining time when activeFast + reminders.endEnabled and target end is still future). persist key 'heula-store', version 1, migrate stub. startFast resolves targetHours/planLabel from the store via resolveTargetHours/resolvePlanLabel (custom -> customFastingHours and `Custom {h}j`, never catalog 16) and snapshots into activeFast; stopFast computes completed = durationMs >= targetMs once and copies the snapshot verbatim into the FastingSessionRecord before writing to Dexie and clearing activeFast. editStartTime rejects future startMs; resetAll clears Dexie and resets to defaults with hydrated=true. db.ts is a top-level singleton `export const db = new HeulaDB()` with stores({ sessions: '++id, startMs, createdAt, completed, planId' }), no window guard/factory. sessions.ts (add/remove/all/clear/last7Days) each try/catch with dev-only console.error, returning recoverable no-op defaults. Verification: `npx tsc --noEmit` passes; `npx vitest run src/lib` passes 105/105 (no regression).
